panel.offline_hint: Connect the earbuds in the system Bluetooth settings; the plugin retries automatically.
panel.find_hint: Ring the earbuds to locate them
panel.volume_hint: Volume of the earbuds' own prompts

tooltip.scroll: Scroll or right-click to cycle the listening mode

error.command_missing: The EncoBuds CLI was not found. Install the project or set its path in the plugin settings.

command.label: CLI command
command.description: Path to the encobuds executable. Empty auto-detects ~/.agent/EncoBuds/encobuds, ~/.local/bin/encobuds, PATH, then runs the project launcher with python3.

mac.label: Earbuds MAC
mac.description: Override the address the CLI uses. Empty reads ~/.config/encobuds/config.json, then the Bluetooth device list.

channel.label: RFCOMM channel
channel.description: Force a control channel. 0 lets the CLI discover it over SDP.

refresh.label: Refresh interval
refresh.description: Seconds between status polls while the plugin is loaded.

show_devices.label: Show devices in panel
show_devices.description: List the earbuds' remembered devices with connect/disconnect buttons.

show_mode.label: Show mode
show_mode.description: Show the listening mode next to the bar glyph.

show_battery.label: Show battery
show_battery.description: Show the lowest earbud battery next to the bar glyph.

hide_when_offline.label: Hide when offline
hide_when_offline.description: Hide the bar widget while the earbuds are not connected.

scroll_cycle.label: Scroll to cycle
scroll_cycle.description: Scroll over the bar widget to cycle off → smart ANC → transparency.

device_name.label: Display name
device_name.description: Name shown at the top of the panel. Empty uses the detected model (e.g. OPPO Enco Air5 Pro).

show_product_image.label: Show product image
show_product_image.description: Show the OPPO Enco Air5 Pro render in the panel.
